comment: The published archives each dialect's negative claim authority was read against, mirrored out of the Rust tables so a consumer outside this crate can ask whether an installed tree is one the authority can answer about. Pinned field by field by `audited_archives_json_mirrors_the_dialect_tables` in src/lib.rs: a re-audit that changes a tuple fails that test until this file follows. Never a proof surface -- matching a tuple here says only that the identity gate in contract_certification/type_facts.rs could be reached, never that any row denies anything.
